items.title: Google Gemini API Managed Agents ships scheduled triggers, budget controls, and free tier

key_claims.claim: Cron-scheduled triggers bind agents to recurring tasks without external orchestration
max_total_tokens cap pauses execution gracefully if budget reached
Environment hooks target specific tools via regex in .agents/hooks.json
Free tier now available without active billing
Default model: Gemini 3.6 Flash (antigravity-preview-05-2026 agent)

items.title: NVIDIA founds Open Secure AI Alliance with 37 organizations; open-sources NOOA agent-tracing framework

key_claims.claim: 37 founding organizations (The Hacker News count from announcement day)
NVIDIA blog lists 60+ current members (likely reflects post-announcement joiners)
OpenAI, Google, Anthropic absent from founding members
NOOA (NVIDIA Labs Object-Oriented Agent): Apache 2.0 research framework for agent traceability and governance
IBM/Red Hat Lightwell, Microsoft MDASH, Hugging Face Safetensors among day-one contributions
Formation triggered by July 22 OpenAI/HuggingFace breach incident

caveats: Founding member count conflicts across sources (37 vs 52 vs 60+; see conflicts field)
NOOA is labeled a research framework; production maturity unconfirmed
items.conflicts: Member count: NVIDIA blog says 60+, THN says 37, betanews says 52. Reconciliation: 37 used as founding count (announcement day); NVIDIA blog likely reflects later joiners.

items.title: AI Kill Switch Act: bipartisan US bill requires shutdown capability for frontier AI systems

key_claims.claim: Introduced by Rep. Ted Lieu (D-CA) and Rep. Nathaniel Moran (R-TX)
Compute threshold: systems developed with >$100M compute
Revenue threshold: companies earning >$500M annually from covered systems
DHS authority: throttle, suspend, or shut down covered systems
Penalties: $2M–$20M per day non-compliance
Supporting orgs: AI Policy Network, Americans for Responsible Innovation, ControlAI, Future of Life Institute, Alliance for Secure AI

caveats: Bill introduced in committee; no committee vote or floor vote scheduled as of July 29, 2026
Primary source date July 23 is one day outside the 5-day expansion window; included because absent from all prior bulletins in this period and verifiable
